title: Army veteran sues federal government after ICE detains him for three days
summary: US citizen George Retes was held without access to family, an attorney, or information about the charges against him An army veteran detained by federal immigration agents in southern California during his work commute in July has filed a lawsuit against the federal government. According to the lawsuit , filed on Wednesday with the help of the nonprofit law firm Institute for Justice, George Retes was held in a detention center for three days without access to his family, an attorney, or any information about the charges against him, in what the suit argues was an unconstitutional detention.
